notes.title: 1.0.0 Release
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to [url=https://virtualorator.com/blog/1-0-release/]announce our 1.0.0 release[/url]. 

This represents fulfillment of our original feature list and the start of the next phase of development with much more planned for 1.X and releases beyond.

New session menu and pause awareness during system interactions and removal of headset
Reset Orientation now part of session menu and bindings no longer function
Potential fix for bug that stopped loading at Seating Audience that affected small percentage of people

Known limitations
some 'link' All-in-One HMD do not properly report the user being absent, so headset removal detection does not work.
